title: Lab - Certificates API
description: Onboard a new user through a CSR.
scenario: Onboard a new user through a CSR. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Submit
tasks.instructions: Create a CSR object for user akshay from akshay.csr, signer kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client.
tasks.solution:
cat akshay.csr | base64 -w0  # into spec.request
kubectl apply -f akshay-csr.yaml

tasks.title: Task 2 - Approve
tasks.instructions: Approve it and extract the signed certificate.
tasks.solution:
kubectl certificate approve akshay
kubectl get csr akshay -o jsonpath='{.status.certificate}' | base64 -d > akshay.crt

tasks.title: Task 3 - Deny
tasks.instructions: A CSR from agent-smith asks for system:masters. Reject it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl get csr agent-smith -o yaml
kubectl certificate deny agent-smith
